data.text: Hi, yeah, so my internet has been really slow for the last couple of days and I'm not sure what's going on. I've tried unplugging my router once but it didn't really help much.

I'll help you diagnose this. First, I need your customer ID to pull up your account and run some diagnostics. Can you provide that?

Once I have it, I'll check:
- Your modem status and signal levels
- Whether there are any outages in your area
- Your connection quality to the internet backbone
- Your support history to see if there's a pattern

What's your customer ID?
